entities.summary: Nobuyuki "Nobu" Matsuhisa  is a Japanese celebrity chef and restaurateur known for his fusion cuisine blending traditional Japanese dishes with Peruvian ingredients. His signature dish is black cod in miso. He has restaurants bearing his name in several countries and major cities such as New York, London, Paris, Los Angeles, Sydney, Hong Kong and Tokyo. He has also played small parts in three major films.
